coreProblem: Style OS solves the problem of daily wardrobe fatigue by providing personalized styling solutions based on user preferences and local weather.
targetAudience: Fashion-conscious individuals, particularly those with busy lifestyles or limited time to style their outfits.
coreFeatures: Auto-detecting photo capture for categorizing clothing items
Real-time outfit recommendations based on weather and personal profile
Virtual try-on tool for saving favorite looks
techStackHints: Machine learning algorithms for image recognition and styling suggestions
Cloud storage for user data and photos
Frontend frameworks like React or Vue.js for the app interface
